setup_distributed_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group using SLURM or local mode with a config dict
cleanup_distributed_and_ray: clean up the distributed process group, Ray, and GP utilities to release ports
all_reduce_tensor_across_ranks: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all ranks with optional averaging
gather_objects_to_master_rank: gather pickleable objects from all ranks into a list on the master rank
assign_device_for_local_rank: assign a CPU or CUDA device for a given local rank in a distributed job
